content_sections.heading: Panipat Anganwadi Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The department has invited applications to fill vacant Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper positions at different Anganwadi centres in Panipat district. The public notice does not specify the total number of vacancies. Candidates can check the detailed village-wise and ward-wise vacancy information at the concerned WCDPO office or its notice board.

content_sections.heading: Panipat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted during office hours. Applications received after the last date will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Panipat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Female candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit and local residency requirements prescribed by the department. Anganwadi Worker (AWW): Candidates must have passed Class 12. Anganwadi Helper (AWH): Candidates must have passed Class 10. Only eligible women belonging to the concerned village panchayat or ward can apply for the respective Anganwadi vacancies. Applicants should check the village or ward details before submitting their forms. Yes. Women who have passed Class 10 can apply for Anganwadi Helper posts, provided they satisfy the other eligibility conditions. Class 12 is required for Anganwadi Worker posts.

content_sections.heading: Panipat Anganwadi Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The prescribed age limit for Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts is 18 to 42 years . Yes. As per the notification, eligible widowed, divorced, deserted and other specified categories of women may receive age relaxation up to 45 years, subject to departmental rules.

rows.18_years: Up to 45 years for specified eligible categories under departmental rules

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Panipat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep the following documents ready: Educational Qualification Certificates Age Proof Certificate Aadhaar Card Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) Residence Certificate Caste Certificate (if applicable) Experience Certificate (if applicable) Special Category Certificate (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Panipat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible women can apply offline by following these steps: Visit the concerned Women and Child Development Project Officer (WCDPO) office. Obtain the prescribed Anganwadi Worker or Helper application form. Check the vacancies available in your village panchayat or ward. Fill in the required personal and educational details. Attach the necessary documents and certificates. Submit the completed form at the concerned WCDPO office before 30 October 2026 , during office hours.

content_sections.heading: Panipat Anganwadi Application Form 2026 - WCDPO Office Addresses
content_sections.text: Candidates can contact the following WCDPO offices for application forms and vacancy details.

content_sections.heading: Panipat Anganwadi Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts will be conducted according to the prescribed departmental rules and selection standards. The public notice does not provide details about any written examination, interview or merit calculation process.

content_sections.heading: Panipat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Links
content_sections.text: Panipat Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 offers opportunities for eligible 10th and 12th pass women to apply for Anganwadi Helper and Anganwadi Worker posts in their respective villages or wards. Interested candidates should obtain the prescribed application form, check their eligibility and submit the completed application along with the required documents before 30 October 2026 .

faq.question: Q1. What is Haryana Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive conducted by the Women and Child Development Department, Haryana, to fill Anganwadi Worker (AWW) and Anganwadi Sahayika (AWH) posts in Panipat district through offline applications.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Haryana Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Haryana Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 30 October 2026 during office hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Anganwadi Worker?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th standard to apply for the Anganwadi Worker (AWW) post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Anganwadi Sahayika?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 10th standard to apply for the Anganwadi Sahayika (AWH) post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Haryana Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 42 years, with upper age relaxation up to 45 years for widows, divorced, deserted women, and other eligible categories as per departmental rules.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for Haryana Anganwadi posts?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for Haryana Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must obtain the prescribed application form from the concerned WCDPO office, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and submit it by hand at the same WCDPO office during office hours before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. Who is eligible to apply for a specific Anganwadi centre?
faq.answer: Only female candidates belonging to the related Gram Panchayat or Ward are eligible to apply for that specific centre.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the application form be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted at the respective WCDPO office in Panipat district (Israna, Bapoli, Matlauda, Panipat-R, Panipat-U, or Samalkha) depending on the candidate's Gram Panchayat or Ward.
